meaning:
σπαταλάω, -ῶ
(σπατάλη, wantonness, luxury, Sir.27:13 *), [in LXX: Eze.16:49 (שָׁקַט hi.), Sir.21:15 * ;]
to live riotously: 1Ti.5:6, Jas.5:5 (Polyb.).†
SYN.: στρηνιάω, τρυφάω (see Tr., Syn., § liv) (AS)

elsewhere.note: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.
You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.
